LM_scope: All recovered base/R1/R3 task/split corpus aggregates, with paired historical LM intervals wherever saved draws exist.
H3_test_gate: Audit only exact previously examined frozen H3 cohort after hash/history verification; no new official tests.
structural_scope: All required historical six-task/26-representation/three-seed artifact units and receipt/hash/array alignment coverage.
missing_failure_rule: Block affected units; preserve failure, diagnose independently; never refit, change cohort, select alternate favorable unit or relax tolerances.
fresh_vs_inherited: Current CPU panel separate from all-byte verification and inherited full historical numerical audits.
environment: Isolated CPU dependencies, actual versions recorded; never install GPU runtime in A03.
